text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pestilence of cattle in Macedonia because of the lack of fodder in the farms. In the town of Sveti Nikole 356 pigs died, while in the farm Dajferica close to Prilep 60 cows died.
- Health Minister Ilija Filipce says in Macedonian Parliament that "the battle against the pharmaceutical mafia in Macedonia is won".
- Macedonia and EU have initialled an agreement in the area of textile industry. The Macedonian textile products can be distributed on EU markets without limits.

- The owner of the bankrupted TAT financial institution Sonja Nikolovska will sue the Macedonian state. According to Nikolovska the Macedonian state is to be blamed for the collapse of her saving institution. -- Skopje newsroom +389 91 201-196
